title: Engineering MXene/metal composites from MAX phase/metal–Al precursors for high-performance energy conversion and storage
content:

The MXene/metal composites with a 3D porous structure prepared in this work were evaluated for energy conversion and storage applications, using the hydrogen evolution reaction under alkaline conditions as a model system.
